summary: Set the text on any element and hovering shows the tooltip. No code.
overview: Drop it on a button, icon or panel and set the text. Hover shows it through the tooltip system automatically.
useCases: Adding tooltips across a UI without a script per element.
Explaining icons that have no label.

gotchas.title: It needs a tooltip system in the scene
gotchas.body: Without one, hovering does nothing. The trigger holds text; it does not draw anything itself.

gotchas.title: The text is fixed at author time
gotchas.body: For a tooltip whose content depends on state, call the system's Show directly instead.
